_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/zones/test_tucks_itself_bottom.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_tucks_itself_bottom` is the `tucks_itself: "bottom"` rider on a sorcery that also gains 2 life, so the test can see both that the effects ran and where the card went.

cards.name: Test Tucks Itself Bottom
